top_band: slate-blue tiled roof top slope (rows 1-15) and stone basin top rim with water (rows 29-35)
evidence: The structure has a clear 15-row sloped tile roof on top (rows 1-15) with an eave shadow (row 16-17), wooden pillars from rows 17-43, and a water basin below showing a 7-row top rim and recessed water surface (rows 29-35) above a 7-row stone front face (rows 36-42).

style.evidence: While the roof tiles have decent shading, the lower half of the piece is extremely flat compared to the Beodeul well reference: the stone basin front (rows 37-42) is a large 16x6 solid grey rectangle with zero stone texture or variation, the wooden pillars are smooth 2-colour vertical bars, and heavy near-black outlines enclose the shapes.
